reference.note: packaged facets='named' is truthy = all facets (EXP-0044 addendum); manifest level 'named' is the engine's genuine named-only mode

candidate_table.label: frozen v1_3 = v1_2.cfg_of(facets='all', guard=0) + normal pair + grid

frozen_numerics.t3_pair_quadrature: Gauss-Chebyshev-U 40 nodes, theta = sqrt(3) x / sqrt(1-x^2)
frozen_numerics.spike: one extra mu node at exactly G/2 carrying mass 0.5
frozen_numerics.laplace: Newton tol 1e-10, max 100 it, step clip 5.0; mu: 3-point parabola at grid argmax, moment-matched fallback, Gaussian discretised on the grid
frozen_numerics.laplace_scope: normal pair effect and grid priors only (the only registered Laplace rows)

stage1.comparator: frozen v1_3 (M00) under A1 on identical inner-fold episodes
stage1.pass_rule: pooled inner dALC <= -0.0005, >= 2/3 inner-fold means < 0, no inner-fold mean > +0.0005
stage1.advance: baseline + at most 8 passing configs ranked by best passing policy, then table order

stage2.select: lowest pooled inner dALC among passing pairs; ties: table order, then A1/A2/A3/A5/A8

stage3.adoption: mean dALC <= -0.001, pair-bootstrap 95% CI upper < 0, >= 3/4 fold means < 0, no fold delta > +0.0005; selection required in >= 3/4 inner loops

design.bootstrap: v1_1.boot: 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(0), pair-level within folds (and hierarchical fold+pair as secondary); 4-fold t interval with t_{0.975,3}=3.182446305284263

output_schema.container: one .npz per (stage, outer, inner, regime) + JSON summary; per-instance rows not stored
